answer: At dawn, a sparrow must solve a saffron-locked crypto puzzle to join. Each identity’s solution binds to a unique nonce, checked by a cross-referenced audit tree. Fake sparrows reuse nonces? Their vaults burn proportional tokens, and proofs invalidate linearly. Cost: 0.5 token per head, no batch parallelization—the system forces serially computed uniqueness per fake at epoch transitions.
